entities.summary: Michael Alexander Moser is an American retired professional basketball player who currently serves as an assistant coach for the Denver Nuggets of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the University of Oregon as a senior. Moser was an All-American player at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV) before transferring to Oregon in 2013.
